info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Enterprise Services Fixed Asset Register Validation-v5-spec
info.description: The Fixed Asset Register Validation API facilitates the validation of fixed asset registers within banking enterprises. This endpoint allows financial institutions to ensure the accuracy and compliance of their asset records by submitting validation requests. Typically used by asset management teams and compliance officers, this service enhances the reliability of financial reporting and ensures adherence to regulations. It supports operational efficiency by streamlining the validation process for fixed asset registers.

post.summary: Create a validation for the fixed asset register entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a validation for a specific entry in the fixed asset register identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required details are provided in the request body to successfully create a validation.
